stem:
Read this sentence from paragraph 18.

He was convinced he had experienced enough nature to last him for decades.

What does the author achieve by using exaggeration in this sentence?

options.label: A
options.text: The author emphasizes how long it takes Brody and Uncle Stephen to climb the mountain.

options.label: B
options.text: The author conveys that Brody wants to avoid outdoor activities for a very long time.

options.label: C
options.text: The author implies that Brody will never forget his outdoor adventure with Uncle Stephen.

options.label: D
options.text: The author highlights that Brody is amazed by how much he has learned about nature.
